headline.text: Should states mandate kill-switches for frontier AI?

caption: On September 18, 2026, California Governor Gavin Newsom signed an executive order directing a working group to deliver AI safety and security recommendations within two months — a timeline that runs faster than the standard state legislative process, which typically takes six to eighteen months. The proposed measures the group must consider include requiring AI companies to build a kill switch into frontier models and mandating that independent third parties, rather than the companies themselves, draft their safety plans. This report is sourced from a statement issued by the governor's office and has not yet been independently corroborated by outside reporting, so treat the specific mechanism details as preliminary until further confirmation.
